summary.notes: No blockers. 2 major issues are acceptable warnings — both relate to modifier stacking extremes that are correctly flagged for estimator review. All cross-file threading rules pass. Task ID consistency between sop_modules and production verified. All 41 tasks have matching rates.

issues.description: Prep task modifier stack for extreme scenario (heavy rust 2.25 x scaffold 1.60 x ornate 2.25 x QT4 1.15) = 9.32x, far exceeding 4.0x cap. While correctly flagged for estimator review, this represents a 9x baseline labor multiplier which may produce unreliable estimates.
issues.suggested_fix: No fix needed — scenario is correctly flagged. Recommend T&M billing for this combination. Consider adding a hard T&M threshold at 6.0x in the estimation engine.

issues.description: Coating task modifier stack (scaffold 1.60 x ornate 2.25 x QT4 1.15) = 4.14x exceeds 4.0x cap by 3.5%. Minor overshoot but technically above the system-wide cap.
issues.suggested_fix: Accepted — 3.5% overshoot is within tolerance. Engine caps at 4.0x automatically. The estimator review flag catches this case.

issues.description: Three new substrate states proposed (SS_EXT_FLASH_RUST, SS_EXT_MODERATE_RUST, SS_EXT_HEAVY_RUST) that are not yet in controlled_enums.json. These are flagged in resolution.json registry_additions_proposed but have not been added to the registry.
issues.suggested_fix: Add 3 new substrate states to controlled_enums.json in next registry update. Until then, spec is valid with proposed states clearly documented.

issues.description: Total task count is 41 (40 binary + 1 qt_conditional). Slightly above the projected 30-40 range from the brief (41 vs 40 max). The extra task comes from the dedicated interstage module (4 tasks) which was not in NC, plus needle gun and power wash additions.
issues.suggested_fix: No fix needed — separating interstage into its own module follows the RP pattern established by garage door RP and trim RP specs. More structured approach.
